about-me:
Passionate Java/Kotlin full-stack engineer with 4+ years' experience building scalable, serverless, containerized cloud applications using Spring, Micronaut, Quarkus, SvelteKit, and VertX.

Experience with databases (DynamoDB, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and front-end frameworks (React, Vue, SvelteKit). I have experience using Katalon and scenario tests in professional projects.

I enjoy solving real-world problems, learning new technologies, collaborating with teams, and contributing to open source.
